scope: Frozen full Compact builder source and proposed bounded local artifact generation only. No financial source approval, build result acceptance, transaction proof or ledger acceptance.

sourceFindings.finding: Independently recomputed the candidate hash and all 14 source pins; all match. All four review-input hashes match. The staged arithmetic/kernel/wrapper dependency chain uses pinned bytes; wrapper regeneration must equal the stored sources, and source pins are rechecked after compilation.

The actual production path invokes compact compile without --skip-zk and hashes nonempty regular output files under outputDir/case. It requires contract/index.js, compiler/contract-info.json and prover/verifier/zkir/bzkir for the exact three case circuits. Existing installed hello-world compiler metadata independently confirms the 0.31.1/0.23.0/0.16.0 metadata keys and proof=true,pure=false shape; existing prover and bzkir paths confirm layout. This is compatibility evidence, not a performed financial compile.

Resource and review files are digest-bound to admission and candidate; case, output, deadline, maxCompileMs and maxAttempts are cross-checked. Exclusive wx/fsync allocation outside disposable output precedes every subprocess and remains charged after failures and caller counter reset. Atomic exclusion applies to the same attempt path; it is not global admission authentication.

Review files establish bytes and APPROVED candidate fields only, intentionally not reviewer independence or authority. The guarded launcher must authenticate the two scoped reviews and the allocation. CLI prohibits an adapter; programmatic adapters force source-test-only, synthetic=true, proven=false and inspectedProofAssets=false. proofsGenerated remains false even for actual full compilation; no wallet, transaction, ledger or recursive proof acceptance is established.

Direct subprocesses have bounded combined stdout/stderr (1 MiB), deadline checks and process-group SIGKILL on timeout. Whole-tree cleanup, native memory and swap enforcement, serial scheduling, total wall and artifact disk limit are not implemented in this builder. The stipulated external launch containment is mandatory; process-group kill alone is insufficient.

The builder accepts positive admission limits rather than hardcoding this proposal and authenticates version strings/package metadata rather than compiler binary hashes. Admission must bind the specific approved proposal, exact cases and bounds and the installed trusted toolchain. No version subprocess, compiler, proof or network operation was run in this audit.

Artifact size is recorded but not capped, and hashing loads complete files. A 1 GiB output ceiling is distinct from cgroup MemoryMax and the 1 MiB log ceiling. The launch must enforce the proposal output budget during generation and reject excess before acceptance. A successful built receipt remains subject to independent artifact/result review.

resourceRationale: One full key-generation attempt per fixed case is a reasonable bounded diagnostic of whether real prover/verifier artifacts can be produced. Serial execution, 300 s per compile and the stated outer memory/swap/wall limits bound the experiment without asserting feasibility. Approval is conditional on enforcing every stated resource bound, including disk output, and on real admission; prior costs remain charged. Failure or timeout consumes the attempt and requires its own disposition.
preExecutionConditions: Obtain both required fresh independent GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus medium source reviews for this exact candidate, and satisfy the substantive resource-majority rule. This vote alone is not admission.

Resolve applicable guarded-dispatch authority before launching. The inspected Moriarty status currently reports operational-history defects and unresolved admissionRef; this review does not override them.

Implement and inspect the outer launch before execution: serial one-loan plus one-swap, at most one charged compile attempt each, compile time at most 300000 ms each, total wall at most 720000 ms, cleanup reserve 30000 ms, MemoryMax 4294967296, MemorySwapMax 0 and KillMode control-group. Verify actual cgroup settings and terminal cleanup/result, not just intended arguments.
Enforce maxOutputBytesPerCase 1073741824 while generating artifacts and reject overflow; memory containment and post-hoc byte recording do not enforce this disk budget.

Bind each immutable allocation/request to this resource proposal, candidate, case, normalized fresh output, absolute deadline and stable persistent attempt path. Keep attempt/allocation records outside disposable output. Do not create replacement allocation identities to reset attempts; retain all existing prior charges.

Keep reviewed source and toolchain stable for execution, use the real production command without adapter/skip/mock, preserve failure/timeout/partial output evidence, and perform independent review of actual receipts/artifact hashes and cgroup outcomes before accepting a build.
